wordHints.Ball-jointed: Ball-jointed dolls are poseable figures with articulated joints, so this clue points to a specific doll format.
wordHints.Bobblehead: Bobbleheads are novelty dolls or figures with oversized spring-mounted heads, which still fits the broader doll category.
wordHints.Voodoo: Voodoo doll is a familiar phrase in popular culture, even though this clue feels more symbolic than toy-like at first.
wordHints.Russian nesting (Matryoshka): Matryoshka dolls are the classic Russian nesting dolls, making this the clearest traditional doll clue on the board.
wordHints.Barbie: Barbie is the famous fashion doll brand and often the quickest anchor for the whole set.

fullAnalysis: Puzzle #682 looks messy on purpose because the clues come from very different corners of culture. Ball-jointed suggests collector figures, Bobblehead points to novelty merchandise, Voodoo feels ritualistic and symbolic, Russian nesting (Matryoshka) evokes traditional wooden crafts, and Barbie reads like a toy brand rather than a category. That spread across hobbies, folklore, gifts, and pop culture is what makes the board feel harder than it really is at first glance.

The board resolves once you stop searching for a phrase and ask what each clue literally names. Every clue is a recognizable type of doll: ball-jointed dolls are articulated collector figures, bobbleheads are spring-headed novelty dolls, voodoo dolls are well-known symbolic effigies in popular culture, matryoshka dolls are nested wooden dolls, and Barbie is a fashion doll line. Because all five clues fit that same bucket cleanly, the answer is Types of doll.
solutionNarrative: I started with Barbie because it is the least ambiguous clue on the board. Once I framed Barbie as a doll clue rather than only a brand name, Bobblehead and Ball-jointed both snapped into place quickly. That told me the puzzle probably wanted a broad category rather than a single suffix or compound phrase.

Voodoo was the hesitation clue because it feels thematic instead of toy-like, but voodoo doll is still a standard phrase in popular culture. Russian nesting (Matryoshka) sealed it because matryoshka dolls are a famous traditional form. Once every clue could be described naturally as a kind of doll, the board resolved cleanly.
